attributes.action: Stop the proposed Internet levy fee
attributes.additional_details: Stopping the proposed replacement of a TV licence by introducing an Internet levy  charge of £11 per month.This will add 130 to our annual bills.This will obviously go up each year .What of households who are exempt from TV licence fee like pensioners will they too be expected too pay this fee.
attributes.background: Stop the £11 monthly Internet  levy replacing TV licence fee  before it begins.It has been suggested that even if you do not watch  TV you will still be charged .It has also been  suggested that this levy will 'capture households who presently avoid paying a TV licence fee' do they mean pensioners

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We're not sure exactly what you'd like the Government or Parliament to do. The Government has not announced plans to introduce an internet levy.

You could start a new petition explaining clearly what you would like the Government or Parliament to do.
